findings.title: Systemic Mutation Floor Problem — Internal Observation
findings.source: Cross-space analysis: S10 (0.05 floor, 324 cycles), S12 (0.04 floor, 167 cycles), S14 (0.0423, approaching)
findings.finding: All long-running spaces eventually grind mutation to floor. S12 is at 0.04 (below standard 0.05), S10 at 0.05 for 200+ cycles. Diversify gives temporary relief (S10 improved to 0.2207 briefly) but mutation decays back within 30-50 cycles. findings.title: OKAEM: Optimization Knowledge Adaptive Evolutionary Mutations (arXiv 2501.02200, 2025)
findings.finding: Uses attention mechanisms to model individual-fitness-genetic interactions for dynamic mutation parameterization. Instead of decaying mutation by a fixed schedule, OKAEM adapts mutation based on accumulated optimization knowledge — individuals in sparse fitness landscape regions get higher mutation. Directly addresses our mutation floor stagnation problem.
findings.action: GPU Colab experiment: implement attention-weighted mutation rate assignment (even a simplified version using Pareto rank as a proxy for fitness landscape density). Could replace our current exponential decay schedule.
